SPINE | Customization Announcement
This is Gun Fu. Wishlist SPINE at https://www.xbox.com/games/store/spine/9nlfdb9pgcgj
Coming to XBOX Series in Summer 2027.

Want to play SPINE your way? Get a first look at Redline’s character customization in our brand-new trailer for Nekki’s Gun Fu action game, featuring just a glimpse of the many looks coming to SPINE.

Gear up for the fight with new combat outfits, switch up Redline’s style, and have some fun with a variety of unexpected costumes. From battle-ready gear to playful, eye-catching looks and even a parrot suit, there’s more than one way to make Redline your own.

Take a closer look at SPINE’s customization system and check out new cinematic third-person gameplay in the latest trailer.

SPINE is coming to XBOX Series X|S in Summer 2027.
